verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Grafana serves an llms.txt at grafana.com/llms.txt, a 'Grafana documentation' index aimed at LLMs. A second probe shows the docs pages are also served as raw markdown (.md endpoints), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt or markdown-docs offering for agents, and independent or hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
